name: Pulled Guinea Hen Corn Chowder (Careful / Strain Corn)
whyItWorks: Creamy Yukon Gold potato broth and shredded poultry are soothing, but whole sweet corn kernels have insoluble outer hulls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Reserve for steady/good days and chew thoroughly, or eat the creamy potato broth and shredded poultry while leaving whole corn kernels at the bottom of the bowl.
